## First-time trial report

### What worked
- Added three tasks using the input and **Add** button:
  - “Buy oat milk”
  - A longer dentist-appointment task
  - “Take recycling out”
- Marking “Buy oat milk” complete worked: it became checked and struck through, and the remaining count changed from **3 left** to **2 left**.
- **Delete** worked, so I could remove the test tasks individually when tidying up.
- **All** displayed the tasks together.

### What behaved differently than expected
- The empty list displayed **“undefined”** instead of a normal empty-state message. This appeared both at the start and after deleting everything.
- The filters appeared reversed:
  - **Active** showed the completed, struck-through task.
  - **Completed** showed the unfinished tasks.
- The long task was cut off at “Book a dentist appointment for.” It did not wrap or show an ellipsis, so most of the description was invisible.
- I tried renaming “Take recycling out” to “Take recycling and cardboard out.” The text changed in the edit field, but clicking **Save** twice did not close edit mode or give confirmation, so I could not tell whether the rename had actually been saved.
- **Clear completed** did nothing when clicked twice. I had to use the individual **Delete** buttons to tidy up instead.

Overall, adding, completing, counting, and deleting were straightforward, but the reversed filters and unclear/broken save and cleanup actions made the list unreliable.
